title: Evaluating the Robustness and Accuracy of Text Watermarking Under Real-World Cross-Lingual Manipulations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating identical content translated into different languages using an LLM judge (GPT-Judger) to observe win rates and identify unfair preferences for specific languages (e.g., German over Chinese) regardless of actual text quality.
Comparing the LLM judge's preference between original natural text and perturbed (paraphrased) text generated by the same model family to detect favoritism toward its own generated outputs.
Tracking the win percentage of text options based on whether they were presented as the first or last option in the LLM judge's evaluation prompt to identify ordering preferences.
